HomePage.heroHeadline: Run your entire school from one place
HomePage.heroSubtext: Attendance, exams, fees, the library and parent communication in one system for admins, teachers, students and parents.
HomePage.heroScreenshotAlt: The admin dashboard: attendance trend, students by stage, fees and things that need attention today
HomePage.featuresSubtext: Connected modules that share one roster, so nothing is typed twice.
HomePage.attendanceBody: Mark a whole classroom present, late, absent or excused, and spot patterns across the term.
HomePage.examsBody: Build exams, let students take them online, and publish results to students and parents.
HomePage.feesBody: Charge per student or per grade, record payments, and see what's still outstanding.
HomePage.libraryBody: Share books and resources with the grades that need them.
HomePage.calendarBody: Holidays, exams and events in one calendar every role can see.
HomePage.structureBody: Stages, grades, classrooms and academic years: set up once, used everywhere.
HomePage.portalsSubtext: Everyone signs in to their own view, with only what they need.
HomePage.portalAdminTitle: See the whole school at a glance
HomePage.portalAdminBody: Attendance, fees and enrollments with their trends, and what needs your attention today.
HomePage.portalAdminPoint3: Decide what each staff account can manage
HomePage.portalTeacherTitle: Your classes, ready when you are
HomePage.portalTeacherBody: Take attendance, build and grade exams, and schedule online lessons for your classrooms.
HomePage.portalParentTitle: Follow every child in one place
HomePage.portalParentBody: Attendance, grades and fees for each of your children, even across different schools.
HomePage.portalParentPoint1: Attendance and grades as they happen
HomePage.portalStudentBody: Exams to take, your results, attendance, subjects and the books for your grade.
HomePage.howHeading: Up and running in three steps
HomePage.step1Body: Sign up, name your school, and you're its admin. It takes a few minutes.
HomePage.step2Body: Add stages, grades, classrooms and the academic year, then your teachers and students.
HomePage.step3Body: Teachers, students and parents sign in to their own portals, in English or Arabic.
HomePage.pricingHeading: Plans that grow with your school
HomePage.pricingSubtext: New schools start on {plan}. Move up when you need more students, storage or modules.
HomePage.pricingError: Plans couldn't be loaded right now.
HomePage.faqA1: Yes. Every page is available in English and Arabic, and the Arabic version is fully right-to-left, charts included. Anyone can switch language at any time.
HomePage.faqA2: Each person sees only what their role allows. Teachers see their own classrooms, parents see their own children, and students see their own grades, attendance and fees. Admins decide what each staff account can manage.
HomePage.faqQ3: Can one person belong to more than one school?
HomePage.faqA3: Yes. One account can be an admin at one school and a parent at another, and switch between them from the avatar menu.
HomePage.faqQ4: Is each school's data kept separate?
HomePage.faqA4: Yes. Every school's records are separate, and every request is checked against the school and role it's signed in to.
HomePage.faqQ5: Can we move to a bigger plan later?
HomePage.faqA5: Yes. Plans differ by student limit, storage and modules. When you need more, your school moves up and keeps everything it already has.
HomePage.faqQ6: Do we need to install anything?
HomePage.faqA6: No. It runs in the browser on computers, tablets and phones.
HomePage.finalCtaHeading: Ready to bring your school online?
HomePage.finalCtaSubtext: Create your school in a few minutes, and invite your staff when you're ready.
HomePage.footerTagline: One system for your whole school.
